title: Verify deployed spec-required creation and Needs a spec
text: Candidate source tests prove every create path refuses a missing or title-only spec with spec_required, the frontier holds title-only leftovers with needs_spec, the board labels them Needs a spec and doctor HC-items-needing-spec lists them. Release-bound proof must confirm the serving create refuses title-only filing and a live leftover shows Needs a spec on the board.
